measurement.timing: Median wall nanoseconds per workload. Execution excludes compilation and includes setup, batch calls, assertions, verification and session finalization. Amortized cost divides by batch size; it is not an isolated VM instruction measurement.
measurement.memory: GC-accounted allocated and committed bytes after execution; retained bytes after full collection must equal the warmed baseline. Not process RSS or peak history bytes.
measurement.matching: Custom predicate evaluation counts checked independently by the Vela source. Unconditional builtin any matchers are excluded.
measurement.ordinary_paths: Three Future workloads and two method/field VM workloads have no mock imports; manual interface baselines use the same business signatures as the generated adapters.

validation.debug: All nine GoogleTest executables passed; complete tools.test debug tooling passed 174 tests. Final changed mock paths also passed 15 core scenarios, cancellation/root cleanup and 15 CLI/LSP tests.
validation.release: tools.test release all passed all nine GoogleTest executables and 174 tooling tests. Final changed mock paths also passed 15 core scenarios and 15 CLI/LSP tests.
validation.static_analysis: Repository-wide tools.vl lint: 598 files, zero failures. Final benchmark barrier adjustment additionally passed targeted lint.
validation.benchmark: All 21 registered cases completed seven unique repetitions with no benchmark errors; matcher counts, runtime results and history/frame reclamation checks passed.

comparison_to_previous.reason: The preceding retained entry measures source testing T0-T5; this entry measures mock M0-M5 with a different case set. Ratios are within this run.

measurement.memory: Counter medians retain each suite original units and boundary. Retained bytes are post-GC snapshots; committed bytes and process RSS are distinct. No cumulative-allocation or pause upper-bound claim.
